body.x: DYMO today introduces its first stand-alone label maker with full-color touch screen functionality. Building on its legacy of innovation, DYMO has touched up label maker functionality with an easy to use screen—and its highest print speed yet.

Get in touch with your organized side by using the new DYMO LabelManager 500TS label maker to create text for a label using its computer-style keyboard, and then easily edit and format labels by simply tapping on the large touch screen. It prints labels twice as fast as its DYMO predecessors, making it ideal for tackling big projects quickly and easily.

“With revolutionary touch screen functionality and speedy printing, our DYMO LabelManager 500TS is breaking new ground in the stand-alone label maker marketplace,” said Julie Hibbard, senior manager of brand marketing for DYMO. “By combining existing DYMO features with touch screen technology, it gives customers an easy-to-use and efficient solution for creating high volumes of labels.”

Like many DYMO label makers, the LabelManager 500TS prints labels when connected to a PC* or Mac®*, but can also be used independent of a computer. It uses DYMO Label™ Software to customize and format labels for immediate printing, or to download them for editing and printing on the go.

The LabelManager 500TS will be available in catalogs and online during the first quarter of 2012 for USD $199.99. Compatible with Microsoft® Windows® XP, Windows Vista®, Windows® 7 or Mac OS® v10.4 or later
